_doc: Each faction's special weapons (openspec/changes/special-weapons/design.md). Every number is a placeholder until the combat change, written so a captain can feel the weapon's idea. The weapons range mockup (docs/mockups/special-weapons.html) inlines this file and computes every readout from it; the game does not read it yet (the change's tasks). Units in every key: km, s, E (energy points), m/s, x (a multiplier), deg. faction: who fields it. fits: where it goes on a ship: a class id list for a fixed mount, 'torpedo' for a load any torpedo tube can take (SFC3 printed pages 28-29: loadout by hardpoint), 'spinal' for the Krai spinal cannon mount, 'helm' for a manoeuvre ordered from the helm. aim: as weapons.json (precise or arc).
